remind.title: Want Valiz to remind you?
remind.text: We'll notify you when online check-in opens and 3 hours before your flight.

held.title: Your price is locked!
held.text: Your reservation is awaiting payment. Pay by {date} and your ticket will be issued.
held.guaranteed: The price won't change during this time.
held.notGuaranteed: Your seat is reserved, but the price may change until you pay.
held.expiredText: The payment deadline for this reservation has passed. Search again to book at current prices.

errors.priceChanged: The price changed: the new total is {price}. Search again to continue at the current price.
errors.failed: We couldn't complete the payment right now; please try again shortly.
errors.live: Payments aren't connected yet, so we can't take payment for now.
